prompt: A narrow upstairs landing in an old terraced house seen from a fixed point high at the top of the stairs. Sophie and a second paramedic, a heavy-set man with a grey crew cut and a green uniform jacket with reflective stripes, edge forward side by side along the landing, with Sophie on the left of the frame and the second paramedic on the right, both with their hands held out low and open and their knees slightly bent. Sophie's brows are raised and soft, her eyes fixed ahead and her mouth a little open. The carpet is a worn brown pattern, the wallpaper is peeling at a seam, a coat hangs from a door handle, and a bare bulb in a paper shade is the only light, with a cold blue wash coming up the stairwell from a distant doorway. Muted colour, slight grain. Thanks.
